meaning: The original phrase 'No ... Git operation' was too broad. The authorized review includes read-only Git rev-parse/cat-file inspections of current governing files and the immutable original source blobs. It forbids Git mutations, commits, pushes and publication.
actual_operations: Only read-only Git identities/blobs are used; every owned artifact is external to both the candidate and original draft. No candidate, canonical, repository, dependency or sealed mathematical byte is modified.
independence: Candidate packaging reviewer, previously a separate sealed IE-05 final mathematical referee2. No candidate metadata or proof authorship in this task. This is not an additional mathematical approval.
